messages.author: a0303ffc0469a3b5
messages.subject: turn borders off?
parts:
Hi all, I have been looking for a way to turn the borders off as they don't render well in small maps written in .pdf format and opened in Adobe Reader.

Is there a way to turn the borders off?

Thanks in advance,

Peter

messages.author: af271c8777c52f76
messages.subject: Re: [rworldmap group] turn borders off?
parts:
Hello Peter,

A simple and efficient trick is to have borderCol the same as landCol
in your maps.

Best regards,
Jean-Baka

messages.subject: Re: [rworldmap group] turn borders off?
parts:
Hi all, as far as I have seen the trick of having border colors the same as land colors only works for  the rare case with maps that only have one land color.

But maybe I'm wrong?

Thanks again,
Peter
